Lower Text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] ＜Draw 1＞ and trash 1 card in your hand.
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If [Gesomon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, trash any 3 cards under 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers without cards under it can't suspend until the end of their turn.
